theory RSF
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym vec = "real list"
type_synonym mat = "real list"

definition vec_add :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_add v1 v2 = map2 (op +) v1 v2"

definition vec_sub :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_sub v1 v2 = map2 (op -) v1 v2"

definition vec_mul :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_mul v1 v2 = map2 (op *) v1 v2"

definition vec_div :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_div v1 v2 = map2 (op /) v1 v2"

definition vec_scale :: "real \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_scale s v = map (\<lambda>x. s * x) v"

definition clip :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "clip x l u = (if x < l then l else if x > u then u else x)"

definition vec_clip :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "vec_clip l u v = map (\<lambda>x. clip x l u) v"

definition mat_vec_mul :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "mat_vec_mul rows cols mat vec =
    map (\<lambda>i. sum_list (map (\<lambda>j. (mat ! (i * cols + j)) * (vec ! j)) [0..<cols])) [0..<rows]"

definition mat_transpose :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> mat" where
  "mat_transpose rows cols mat =
    [ mat ! (r * cols + c). c \<leftarrow> [0..<cols], r \<leftarrow> [0..<rows] ]"

definition outer_product :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> mat" where
  "outer_product v1 v2 = [ a * b. a \<leftarrow> v1, b \<leftarrow> v2 ]"

record rsf_layer =
  dim :: nat
  s_weights :: mat
  t_weights :: mat
  s_bias :: vec
  t_bias :: vec
  clip_min :: real
  clip_max :: real

definition rsf_layer_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer" where
  "rsf_layer_init dim clip_min clip_max \<equiv> \<lparr>
    dim = dim,
    s_weights = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    t_weights = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    s_bias = replicate dim 0,
    t_bias = replicate dim 0,
    clip_min = clip_min,
    clip_max = clip_max \<rparr>"

record rsf_layer_gradients =
  s_weight_grad :: mat
  t_weight_grad :: mat
  s_bias_grad :: vec
  t_bias_grad :: vec

definition rsf_gradients_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "rsf_gradients_init dim \<equiv> \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    t_weight_grad = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    s_bias_grad = replicate dim 0,
    t_bias_grad = replicate dim 0 \<rparr>"

fun rsf_layer_forward :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2 =
    (let
       d = dim L;
       s_w = s_weights L;
       s_b = s_bias L;
       t_w = t_weights L;
       t_b = t_bias L;
       l = clip_min L;
       u = clip_max L;

       s_out = mat_vec_mul d d s_w x2;
       s_bias_added = vec_add s_out s_b;
       s_clamped = vec_clip l u s_bias_added;
       s_exp = map exp s_clamped;
       y1 = vec_mul x1 s_exp;

       t_out = mat_vec_mul d d t_w y1;
       t_bias_added = vec_add t_out t_b;
       y2 = vec_add x2 t_bias_added
     in (y1, y2))"

fun rsf_layer_inverse :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2 =
    (let
       d = dim L;
       s_w = s_weights L;
       s_b = s_bias L;
       t_w = t_weights L;
       t_b = t_bias L;
       l = clip_min L;
       u = clip_max L;

       t_out = mat_vec_mul d d t_w y1;
       t_bias_added = vec_add t_out t_b;
       x2 = vec_sub y2 t_bias_added;

       s_out = mat_vec_mul d d s_w x2;
       s_bias_added = vec_add s_out s_b;
       s_clamped = vec_clip l u s_bias_added;
       s_exp = map exp s_clamped;
       x1 = vec_div y1 s_exp
     in (x1, x2))"

definition rsf_network_forward :: "rsf_layer list \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_network_forward layers x1 x2 =
    foldl (\<lambda>(y1, y2) L. rsf_layer_forward L y1 y2) (x1, x2) layers"

definition rsf_network_inverse :: "rsf_layer list \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec)" where
  "rsf_network_inverse layers y1 y2 =
    foldr (\<lambda>L (x1, x2). rsf_layer_inverse L x1 x2) layers (y1, y2)"

definition grad_add :: "rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "grad_add g1 g2 = \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = vec_add (s_weight_grad g1) (s_weight_grad g2),
    t_weight_grad = vec_add (t_weight_grad g1) (t_weight_grad g2),
    s_bias_grad = vec_add (s_bias_grad g1) (s_bias_grad g2),
    t_bias_grad = vec_add (t_bias_grad g1) (t_bias_grad g2) \<rparr>"

fun rsf_layer_backward ::
  "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec \<times> rsf_layer_gradients)" where
  "rsf_layer_backward L y1 y2 dy1 dy2 =
    (let
       d = dim L;
       s_w = s_weights L;
       t_w = t_weights L;
       s_b = s_bias L;
       t_b = t_bias L;
       l = clip_min L;
       u = clip_max L;

       t_w_t = mat_transpose d d t_w;

       dt_bias = dy2;
       dt_weight = outer_product dy2 y1;

       dy1_from_t = mat_vec_mul d d t_w_t dy2;
       dy1_total = vec_add dy1 dy1_from_t;

       t_out = mat_vec_mul d d t_w y1;
       t_bias_added = vec_add t_out t_b;
       x2 = vec_sub y2 t_bias_added;

       s_out = mat_vec_mul d d s_w x2;
       s_pre = vec_add s_out s_b;
       s_clamped = vec_clip l u s_pre;
       s_exp = map exp s_clamped;

       x1 = vec_div y1 s_exp;

       dx1 = vec_mul dy1_total s_exp;

       ds_exp = vec_mul dy1_total x1;
       ds_clip = vec_mul ds_exp s_exp;
       clip_indicator = map (\<lambda>v. if v \<ge> l \<and> v \<le> u then 1 else 0) s_pre;
       ds_pre = vec_mul ds_clip clip_indicator;

       ds_weight = outer_product ds_pre x2;

       dx2_from_s = mat_vec_mul d d (mat_transpose d d s_w) ds_pre;
       dx2 = vec_add dy2 dx2_from_s
     in (dx1, dx2,
         \<lparr>s_weight_grad = ds_weight,
          t_weight_grad = dt_weight,
          s_bias_grad = ds_pre,
          t_bias_grad = dt_bias\<rparr>))"

definition zero_gradients :: "rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "zero_gradients grads \<equiv> \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (s_weight_grad grads),
    t_weight_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (t_weight_grad grads),
    s_bias_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (s_bias_grad grads),
    t_bias_grad = map (\<lambda>_. 0) (t_bias_grad grads) \<rparr>"

lemma vec_add_length: "length (vec_add v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_add_def)

lemma vec_sub_length: "length (vec_sub v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_sub_def)

lemma vec_mul_length: "length (vec_mul v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_mul_def)

lemma vec_div_length: "length (vec_div v1 v2) = min (length v1) (length v2)"
  by (simp add: vec_div_def)

lemma map_exp_length: "length (map exp v) = length v"
  by simp

lemma vec_clip_length: "length (vec_clip l u v) = length v"
  by (simp add: vec_clip_def)

lemma mat_vec_mul_length:
  assumes "length mat = rows * cols" "length vec = cols"
  shows "length (mat_vec_mul rows cols mat vec) = rows"
  using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_def)

lemma mat_transpose_length: "length (mat_transpose rows cols mat) = cols * rows"
  by (simp add: mat_transpose_def)

lemma outer_product_length: "length (outer_product v1 v2) = length v1 * length v2"
  by (simp add: outer_product_def)

lemma vec_div_mul_cancel:
  assumes "length v1 = length v2"
  assumes "\<forall>i < length v2. v2 ! i \<noteq> 0"
  shows "vec_div (vec_mul v1 v2) v2 = v1"
proof -
  have "length (vec_mul v1 v2) = length v1"
    using assms(1) by (simp add: vec_mul_length)
  then show ?thesis
    using assms
    unfolding vec_div_def vec_mul_def
    apply (intro nth_equalityI)
     apply simp_all
    apply (metis assms(1) assms(2) length_map nth_map)
    done
qed

lemma vec_add_sub_cancel:
  assumes "length v1 = length v2"
  shows "vec_sub (vec_add v1 v2) v2 = v1"
proof -
  have "length (vec_add v1 v2) = length v1"
    using assms by (simp add: vec_add_length)
  then show ?thesis
    using assms
    unfolding vec_sub_def vec_add_def
    apply (intro nth_equalityI)
     apply simp_all
    apply (metis assms length_map nth_map)
    done
qed

theorem rsf_layer_forward_shape:
  assumes "length x1 = dim L" "length x2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (y1, y2) = rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2
         in length y1 = dim L \<and> length y2 = dim L"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  have s_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L) x2) = ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have s_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L) x2) (s_bias L)) = ?d"
    using assms s_out_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)
  have s_exp_len:
    "length (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L)
              (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L) x2) (s_bias L)))) = ?d"
    using s_bias_len by (simp add: map_exp_length vec_clip_length)
  have y1_len:
    "length (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L)
              (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L) x2) (s_bias L))))) = ?d"
    using assms s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)
  have t_out_len:
    "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L)
              (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L)
                (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L) x2) (s_bias L)))))) = ?d"
    using assms y1_len by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have t_bias_len:
    "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L)
              (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L)
                (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L) x2) (s_bias L)))))) (t_bias L)) = ?d"
    using assms t_out_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)
  have y2_len:
    "length (vec_add x2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L)
              (vec_mul x1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L)
                (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L) x2) (s_bias L)))))) (t_bias L))) = ?d"
    using assms t_bias_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)
  show ?thesis
    using y1_len y2_len by (simp add: Let_def)
qed

theorem rsf_layer_inverse_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim L" "length y2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (x1, x2) = rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2
         in length x1 = dim L \<and> length x2 = dim L"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  have t_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) = ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have t_bias_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) (t_bias L)) = ?d"
    using assms t_out_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)
  have x2_len: "length (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) (t_bias L))) = ?d"
    using assms t_bias_len by (simp add: vec_sub_length)
  have s_out_len:
    "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L)
              (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) (t_bias L)))) = ?d"
    using assms x2_len by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)
  have s_bias_len:
    "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L)
              (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) (t_bias L)))) (s_bias L)) = ?d"
    using assms s_out_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)
  have s_exp_len:
    "length (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L)
              (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L)
                (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) (t_bias L)))) (s_bias L)))) = ?d"
    using s_bias_len by (simp add: map_exp_length vec_clip_length)
  have x1_len:
    "length (vec_div y1 (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L)
              (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L)
                (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) (t_bias L)))) (s_bias L))))) = ?d"
    using assms s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_div_length)
  show ?thesis
    using x1_len x2_len by (simp add: Let_def)
qed

theorem rsf_layer_invertibility:
  assumes "length x1 = dim L" "length x2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  assumes "\<forall>i < dim L.
    (map exp (vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L)
      (vec_add (mat_vec_mul (dim L) (dim L) (s_weights L) x2) (s_bias L))) ! i) \<noteq> 0"
  shows "rsf_layer_inverse L (fst (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) (snd (rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2)) = (x1, x2)"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?s_w = "s_weights L"
  let ?t_w = "t_weights L"
  let ?s_b = "s_bias L"
  let ?t_b = "t_bias L"
  let ?l = "clip_min L"
  let ?u = "clip_max L"

  let ?s_pre = "vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w x2) ?s_b"
  let ?s_cl = "vec_clip ?l ?u ?s_pre"
  let ?s_e = "map exp ?s_cl"
  let ?y1 = "vec_mul x1 ?s_e"

  let ?t_pre = "mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w ?y1"
  let ?t_ba = "vec_add ?t_pre ?t_b"
  let ?y2 = "vec_add x2 ?t_ba"

  have y_fwd: "rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2 = (?y1, ?y2)"
    by (simp add: Let_def)

  have sub_cancel: "vec_sub ?y2 ?t_ba = x2"
  proof -
    have "length x2 = length ?t_ba"
      using assms
      by (simp add: vec_add_length mat_vec_mul_length)
    then show ?thesis
      unfolding \<open>?y2 = vec_add x2 ?t_ba\<close>
      by (simp add: vec_add_sub_cancel)
  qed

  have inv_eval:
    "rsf_layer_inverse L ?y1 ?y2 =
      (vec_div ?y1 (map exp (vec_clip ?l ?u (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w (vec_sub ?y2 ?t_ba)) ?s_b))),
       vec_sub ?y2 ?t_ba)"
    by (simp add: Let_def)

  have div_cancel: "vec_div ?y1 ?s_e = x1"
  proof -
    have len_y1: "length ?y1 = ?d"
      using assms by (simp add: vec_mul_length map_exp_length vec_clip_length vec_add_length mat_vec_mul_length)
    have len_se: "length ?s_e = ?d"
      using assms by (simp add: map_exp_length vec_clip_length vec_add_length mat_vec_mul_length)
    have "vec_div (vec_mul x1 ?s_e) ?s_e = x1"
      apply (rule vec_div_mul_cancel)
       using assms len_se by simp
      using assms len_se by simp
    then show ?thesis
      by (simp add: \<open>?y1 = vec_mul x1 ?s_e\<close>)
  qed

  show ?thesis
    unfolding y_fwd
    unfolding inv_eval
    unfolding sub_cancel
    apply (simp add: div_cancel)
    done
qed

lemma rsf_network_forward_shape_gen:
  assumes "length x1 = d" "length x2 = d"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. dim L = d"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_weights L) = d * d \<and> length (t_weights L) = d * d"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_bias L) = d \<and> length (t_bias L) = d"
  shows "let (y1, y2) = rsf_network_forward layers x1 x2
         in length y1 = d \<and> length y2 = d"
  using assms
proof (induction layers arbitrary: x1 x2)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by (simp add: rsf_network_forward_def Let_def)
next
  case (Cons L ls)
  have Ldim: "dim L = d" using Cons.prems by simp
  have Lw: "length (s_weights L) = d * d" "length (t_weights L) = d * d"
    using Cons.prems by simp_all
  have Lb: "length (s_bias L) = d" "length (t_bias L) = d"
    using Cons.prems by simp_all
  have step_shape:
    "let (y1', y2') = rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2 in length y1' = d \<and> length y2' = d"
    using rsf_layer_forward_shape[of x1 L x2] Cons.prems Ldim Lw Lb by simp
  obtain y1' y2' where step_def: "rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2 = (y1', y2')"
    by (cases "rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2") auto
  have y1'_len: "length y1' = d" and y2'_len: "length y2' = d"
    using step_shape step_def by (simp add: Let_def)
  have IH_use:
    "let (z1, z2) = rsf_network_forward ls y1' y2' in length z1 = d \<and> length z2 = d"
    using Cons.IH[of y1' y2'] Cons.prems y1'_len y2'_len by simp
  show ?case
    unfolding rsf_network_forward_def
    using step_def IH_use by simp
qed

theorem rsf_network_forward_shape:
  assumes "layers \<noteq> []"
  assumes "length x1 = dim (hd layers)" "length x2 = dim (hd layers)"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. dim L = dim (hd layers)"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L \<and> length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_bias L) = dim L \<and> length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (y1, y2) = rsf_network_forward layers x1 x2
         in length y1 = dim (hd layers) \<and> length y2 = dim (hd layers)"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim (hd layers)"
  have dims: "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. dim L = ?d"
    using assms by simp
  have ws: "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_weights L) = ?d * ?d \<and> length (t_weights L) = ?d * ?d"
    using assms dims by auto
  have bs: "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_bias L) = ?d \<and> length (t_bias L) = ?d"
    using assms dims by auto
  show ?thesis
    using rsf_network_forward_shape_gen[of x1 ?d x2 layers] assms dims ws bs by simp
qed

lemma rsf_network_inverse_shape_gen:
  assumes "length y1 = d" "length y2 = d"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. dim L = d"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_weights L) = d * d \<and> length (t_weights L) = d * d"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_bias L) = d \<and> length (t_bias L) = d"
  shows "let (x1, x2) = rsf_network_inverse layers y1 y2
         in length x1 = d \<and> length x2 = d"
  using assms
proof (induction layers)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by (simp add: rsf_network_inverse_def Let_def)
next
  case (Cons L ls)
  have IH0:
    "let (u1, u2) = rsf_network_inverse ls y1 y2 in length u1 = d \<and> length u2 = d"
    using Cons.IH Cons.prems by simp
  obtain u1 u2 where u_def: "rsf_network_inverse ls y1 y2 = (u1, u2)"
    by (cases "rsf_network_inverse ls y1 y2") auto
  have u1_len: "length u1 = d" and u2_len: "length u2 = d"
    using IH0 u_def by (simp add: Let_def)
  have Ldim: "dim L = d" using Cons.prems by simp
  have Lw: "length (s_weights L) = d * d" "length (t_weights L) = d * d"
    using Cons.prems by simp_all
  have Lb: "length (s_bias L) = d" "length (t_bias L) = d"
    using Cons.prems by simp_all
  have step_shape:
    "let (v1, v2) = rsf_layer_inverse L u1 u2 in length v1 = d \<and> length v2 = d"
    using rsf_layer_inverse_shape[of u1 L u2] u1_len u2_len Lw Lb Ldim by simp
  show ?case
    unfolding rsf_network_inverse_def
    using u_def step_shape by simp
qed

theorem rsf_network_inverse_shape:
  assumes "layers \<noteq> []"
  assumes "length y1 = dim (hd layers)" "length y2 = dim (hd layers)"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. dim L = dim (hd layers)"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L \<and> length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "\<forall>L \<in> set layers. length (s_bias L) = dim L \<and> length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (x1, x2) = rsf_network_inverse layers y1 y2
         in length x1 = dim (hd layers) \<and> length x2 = dim (hd layers)"
proof -

theorem rsf_layer_backward_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim L" "length y2 = dim L"
  assumes "length dy1 = dim L" "length dy2 = dim L"
  assumes "length (s_weights L) = dim L * dim L" "length (t_weights L) = dim L * dim L"
  assumes "length (s_bias L) = dim L" "length (t_bias L) = dim L"
  shows "let (dx1, dx2, grads) = rsf_layer_backward L y1 y2 dy1 dy2
         in length dx1 = dim L \<and> length dx2 = dim L \<and>
            length (s_weight_grad grads) = dim L * dim L \<and>
            length (t_weight_grad grads) = dim L * dim L \<and>
            length (s_bias_grad grads) = dim L \<and>
            length (t_bias_grad grads) = dim L"
proof -
  let ?d = "dim L"
  let ?t_w_t = "mat_transpose ?d ?d (t_weights L)"
  have t_w_t_len: "length ?t_w_t = ?d * ?d"
    by (simp add: mat_transpose_length)

  have dy1_from_t_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w_t dy2) = ?d"
    using assms t_w_t_len by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)

  have dy1_total_len: "length (vec_add dy1 (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w_t dy2)) = ?d"
    using assms dy1_from_t_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)

  have t_out_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) = ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)

  have t_bias_added_len: "length (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) (t_bias L)) = ?d"
    using assms t_out_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)

  have x2_len: "length (vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) (t_bias L))) = ?d"
    using assms t_bias_added_len by (simp add: vec_sub_length)

  let ?x2 = "vec_sub y2 (vec_add (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (t_weights L) y1) (t_bias L))"
  let ?s_out = "mat_vec_mul ?d ?d (s_weights L) ?x2"

  have s_out_len: "length ?s_out = ?d"
    using assms x2_len by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)

  let ?s_pre = "vec_add ?s_out (s_bias L)"
  have s_pre_len: "length ?s_pre = ?d"
    using assms s_out_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)

  let ?s_clamped = "vec_clip (clip_min L) (clip_max L) ?s_pre"
  have s_clamped_len: "length ?s_clamped = ?d"
    using s_pre_len by (simp add: vec_clip_length)

  let ?s_exp = "map exp ?s_clamped"
  have s_exp_len: "length ?s_exp = ?d"
    using s_clamped_len by (simp add: map_exp_length)

  let ?x1 = "vec_div y1 ?s_exp"
  have x1_len: "length ?x1 = ?d"
    using assms s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_div_length)

  have dx1_len: "length (vec_mul (vec_add dy1 (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w_t dy2)) ?s_exp) = ?d"
    using dy1_total_len s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)

  let ?ds_exp = "vec_mul (vec_add dy1 (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?t_w_t dy2)) ?x1"
  have ds_exp_len: "length ?ds_exp = ?d"
    using dy1_total_len x1_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)

  let ?ds_clip = "vec_mul ?ds_exp ?s_exp"
  have ds_clip_len: "length ?ds_clip = ?d"
    using ds_exp_len s_exp_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)

  let ?clip_ind = "map (\<lambda>v. if v \<ge> clip_min L \<and> v \<le> clip_max L then 1 else 0) ?s_pre"
  have clip_ind_len: "length ?clip_ind = ?d"
    using s_pre_len by simp

  let ?ds_pre = "vec_mul ?ds_clip ?clip_ind"
  have ds_pre_len: "length ?ds_pre = ?d"
    using ds_clip_len clip_ind_len by (simp add: vec_mul_length)

  have ds_w_len: "length (outer_product ?ds_pre ?x2) = ?d * ?d"
    using ds_pre_len x2_len by (simp add: outer_product_length)

  have dt_w_len: "length (outer_product dy2 y1) = ?d * ?d"
    using assms by (simp add: outer_product_length)

  let ?s_w_t = "mat_transpose ?d ?d (s_weights L)"
  have s_w_t_len: "length ?s_w_t = ?d * ?d"
    by (simp add: mat_transpose_length)

  have dx2_from_s_len: "length (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w_t ?ds_pre) = ?d"
    using assms s_w_t_len ds_pre_len by (simp add: mat_vec_mul_length)

  have dx2_len: "length (vec_add dy2 (mat_vec_mul ?d ?d ?s_w_t ?ds_pre)) = ?d"
    using assms dx2_from_s_len by (simp add: vec_add_length)

  show ?thesis
    using assms dx1_len dx2_len ds_w_len dt_w_len ds_pre_len by (simp add: Let_def)
qed

a csatolt zig fajl bizonyitja ez a thy kód
entries.answer:
Nem: a csatolt Zig fájl önmagában **nem bizonyítja** a mellékelt Isabelle/HOL (.thy) kódot; legfeljebb azt mutatja, hogy van egy implementáció, ami “hasonló” számítást végez.  A .thy kód viszont (ha Isabelle-ben hiba nélkül lefut/elfogadott) valódi, gépileg ellenőrzött formális bizonyítás *a benne formalizált absztrakt modellről* — nem automatikusan a Zig programról.[1]

## Mit bizonyít a .thy valójában?
A .thy-ben definiált “RSF layer” egy absztrakt, tisztán funkcionális modell: listákon (real list) értelmezett vektor/mátrix műveletek, “clip”, “exp”, forward/inverse, és ezekhez kapcsolódó lemmák/tételek (alakhelyesség, invertálhatóság feltételek mellett). Ez formális verifikáció *abban az értelemben*, hogy Isabelle/HOL-ban a bizonyításokat a kernel ellenőrzi, de kizárólag arra a matematikai definícióra nézve, amit ott megadtál (pl. reál számokkal, ideális \(exp\)-pel, list-indexeléssel, stb.).

## Mit tartalmaz és mit állít a Zig fájl?
A `rsf.txt` egy Zig implementációt ad `RSFLayer` és `RSF` struktúrákkal, `forward`, `inverse`, `backward` függvényekkel, shape-ellenőrzésekkel (`assertPair`), klippeléssel/exp-pel, és numerikus “védőkorlátokkal” (`clampFiniteInPlace`, illetve hibadobás ha az exp eredménye 0 vagy nem véges).  Emellett a súlyok inicializálása random Xavier-szerű uniform eloszlással történik, és van “grad_mean” skálázás is a gradiens-akkumulációban.[1]

## Miért nem “bizonyítja” a Zig a .thy-t?
Ahhoz, hogy “a Zig bizonyítja a .thy-t” igaz legyen, kellene egy *formális megfelelési (refinement/correctness) tétel*, ami kimondja, hogy a Zig program szemantikája megfelel az Isabelle-definícióknak, és ezt is formálisan le kellene vezetni. Itt több lényegi rés is látszik: a .thy reál aritmetikát és listákat használ, míg a Zig `f32`-t, batch-dimenziós tenzorokat, transzponálás/matmul primitíveket, illetve explicit “nem véges” értékek lenullázását alkalmazza, ami megváltoztathatja a matematikai függvényt.[1]

## Mitől lenne ez valódi end-to-end verifikáció?
Ha tényleg azt akarod, hogy “a Zig kód helyes az Isabelle-spec szerint”, tipikusan ezek valamelyike kell:
- Zig szemantika (vagy egy jól definiált rész-nyelv) formalizálása Isabelle-ben, majd korrektness/refinement bizonyítás a Zig implementáció és a .thy-spec között.
- Vagy a specifikáció olyan Isabelle-könyvtárban/keretben, amihez van bizonyított kódgenerálás és futtatási megfelelés (és akkor a futó kód a generált kód lenne, nem egy külön kézzel írt Zig).  
- Minimális “félút”: property-based tesztek (nem formális bizonyítás), ahol sok random esetre ellenőrzöd a forward/inverse invariánsokat és a shape invariánsokat a Zigben; ez viszont továbbra sem formális bizonyítás, csak nagy mintás tesztelés.[1]

Ha megírod pontosan, mit értesz azon, hogy “a Zig fájl bizonyítja” (pl. ugyanazt számolja-e, invertálható-e, gradiensek egyeznek-e, vagy csak shape-kompatibilitás), meg tudom mondani, milyen *konkrét* megfelelési állítást érdemes kitűzni, és azt hogyan lehetne formálisan vagy legalább mérnökileg szigorúan alátámasztani.
